title: Welcome to the Central Shopping Centre
欢迎来到中央购物中心

sentences: Dear customers, welcome to the Central Shopping Centre.
亲爱的顾客们，欢迎来到中央购物中心。
We open at 11 a.m. and close at 9 p.m. from Monday to Sunday.
我们从周一到周日上午11点开门，晚上9点关门。
We sell many products, including clothing, jewellery and accessories, housewares, food and drinks, and much more.
我们销售许多商品，包括服装、珠宝和配饰、厨房用具、食品和饮料，以及更多。
The jewellery and accessory section is on the ground floor.
珠宝和配饰区在底楼。
We sell all types of jewellery, including rings, bracelets, necklaces, earrings which are made of gold, silver and gems.
我们销售各类珠宝，包括金、银和宝石制成的戒指、手镯、项链、耳环。
Accessories are next to jewellery, including leather handbags, purses and wallets, watches, sunglasses, ties and belts.
配饰在珠宝旁边，包括皮革手提包、钱包和皮夹、手表、太阳镜、领带和腰带。
There's also a wide choice of hats, scarves and gloves.
还有各种各样的帽子、围巾和手套可供选择。
The make-up and perfume counters are also on the same floor, where you can buy all sorts of items.
化妆品和香水柜台也在同一层楼，在那里您可以购买各类商品。
The clothing stores and shoe stores are on the first floor.
服装店和鞋店在一楼。
The products we sell include clothing and shoes in the latest fashion for women, men and children.
我们销售的产品包括女士、男士和儿童的最新时尚服装和鞋类。
You can also find sportswear, sports socks, swimming costumes, and sporting equipment on this floor.
您还可以在这一层找到运动服、运动袜、泳衣和运动器材。
On the second floor, there are many restaurant chains.
在二楼有许多连锁餐厅。
There's also a large market where you can buy fresh food.
还有一个大市场，您可以在那里购买新鲜食品。
Customers can pay by credit card, cheque or in cash at any store.
顾客可以在任何商店使用信用卡、支票或现金支付。
After checkout, please keep your receipts which can be used for a refund.
结账后，请保管好您的收据，这些收据可用于退款。
We provide umbrellas and raincoats for shoppers to borrow on rainy days.
我们在雨天为购物者提供雨伞和雨衣借用。
If you have any questions, please feel free to ask our staff for help.
如果您有任何问题，请随时向我们的员工寻求帮助。
They wear blue uniforms.
他们身穿蓝色制服。
We always put "customers first" and "make sure every penny you spend counts".
我们始终秉持「顾客至上」和「确保您花的每一分钱都物有所值」的理念。
Thank you for choosing us and we sincerely hope to see you soon!
感谢您选择我们，真诚希望很快见到您！
